notes.title: Third-Person Open World Game Coming Soon from FrisbyStudio!
notes.notes:
Use Souls-Like combat to defeat the Ninjas in the beautiful city of Tokyo and rescue your sister.
Stay tuned for this third-person open world game located in Tokyo with souls-like combat from developer FrisbyStudio!

notes.title: Xbox Controller Layout
notes.notes: RT is left mouse click, LT is right mouse click, RB is to peak right, LB is to peak left, Menu button is enter key, map button is the escape key, A is to jump, B is to crouch, X is to enter, Y is to equip and remove weapon, Press down on the left joystick to run, up on the directional pad is the 1 key on a keyboard, right is 2, down is 3, and left on the directional pad is 4.

notes.title: The touch screen on Steam Deck can now operate the game menu.
notes.notes: The touch screen on steam deck can now operate the game menu as it functions like a left click on a mouse.
